text: Zoom out and the island reads like a map. Each village's name stands over it, larger for a town, and fades as you zoom in. Roads show as pale lines between villages, villages glow at night as brightly as they have people, dust rises where a house is going up and smoke where one burnt, and carts roll along the roads on market days. The Watch camera now pulls back to the whole island now and then, and the tour of a new island ends there.
